name: Digital colour grade
summary: The whole image is scanned to digital, and its colour is set shot by shot with curves and look-up tables.
how: Push skin tones towards orange (hue 25 to 35 degrees) and shadows towards teal (hue 180 to 200 degrees).
Keep the saturation of skin under 60%.
Use one look-up table for each scene, so that the shots match.

origin.note: O Brother, Where Art Thou? is the first feature film that is graded as a whole in a digital intermediate.

adoptions.via: Photographers apply film-look presets and split toning in Lightroom to push skin to orange and shadows to teal.

sources.title: Alexis Van Hurkman, Color Correction Handbook (2010)
